_comment: Hand-written lore that wins over the scraped wiki text, keyed by uiMapID.
Use this when a wiki intro is entirely post-vanilla, or when you simply want
to write better copy than the wiki has. Supply `full` and optionally `short`;
`short` is derived from `full` when omitted. These are the only lore strings
in the project that are yours rather than CC BY-SA.
